translations.web: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
translations.bsb: The path of the righteous is level; You clear a straight path for the upright.
translations.kjv: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
translations.asv: The way of the just is uprightness: thou that art upright dost direct the path of the just.
